title: Carry-out
text: Doesn't teach Claude how to counsel a client. It's a file of steps Claude reads before it starts. So every letter comes out with the same structure every time. Your turn. Paste this into Claude.

title: Your turn
text: Pick one document I produce the same way every time. Write me a skill MD for it, plain language, ordered steps, then read it back to me and walk me through exactly what you'll do before you do it. Claude client letter, Liam in for bear.
